definitions.explanation: Chemicals used in farming to protect crops from pests, diseases, and weeds.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農薬|のうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていません→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: These vegetables were grown without pesticides.

examples.japanese: {農薬|のうやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|し}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Overuse of pesticides is bad for the environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農薬|のうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {農薬|のうやく} is a general term for all agricultural chemicals, including pesticides, herbicides, and fungicides.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {農薬|のうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use pesticides)
- {農薬|のうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撒|ま}く→撒く：12711_maku⟧ (to spray pesticides)
- ⟦{無|む}{農薬|のうやく}→無農薬：19133_munouyaku⟧ (pesticide-free)
- ⟦{減|げん}{農薬|のうやく}→減農薬：noentry⟧ (reduced pesticides)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {農薬|のうやく}⟦{散布|さんぷ}→散布：21064_sanpu⟧ (pesticide spraying)
- ⟦{残留|ざんりゅう}→残留：18406_zanryuu⟧{農薬|のうやく} (pesticide residue)
- ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧{農薬|のうやく} (organic pesticides)

NOTE: Consumer awareness about {農薬|のうやく} has increased, leading to growth in organic (⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧) and pesticide-free (⟦{無|む}{農薬|のうやく}→無農薬：19133_munouyaku⟧) produce.
